title: 第1736章 他死了你也别活冥鬼教主第1735章 打入内部出事了
slug: 玄幻反派仙域最强太子爷
content_zh:
得到五长老的许诺，那名弟子面色一喜。
他只不过是冥鬼教一个不起眼的小人物，没想到就这么稀里糊涂立了一功。
“多谢五长老！多谢五长老！”
“记住，千万别让手持令牌的那家伙死了，否则……你就去给他陪葬吧。”
语气森然，五长老也不是完全没有要求。
持有令牌的那名来自分部的魔族，肯定掌握着至关重要的消息，绝对不能有半分闪失。
但凡出现一点点差错，他都不会轻易放过眼前这小子。
“是！长老请放心，属下一定不会让他出问题！”
连忙打起十二分精神，毕竟这件事情可是事关他的小命。
一个不小心，很可能就把小命给赔进去。
当他直起身时，却发现五长老已经离开。
不敢有丝毫怠慢，此事关乎他的小命，他立刻返回，必须要保证手持令牌的魔族不能死。
而拿着分部掌教令牌的五长老，却是马不停蹄地赶往冥鬼教大殿。
相较于阴冥山脉的分部，绝冥山脉的总部大了不止数倍。
位于山脉中心腹地的大殿，更是打造得无比的宏伟。
这里是冥鬼教的核心地区，平常也只有一些核心人员才能够进入此地。
五长老连忙闯入大殿，甚至都来不及让人通报。
这件事情十分严重，容不得半点耽搁。
“嘎吱——！！”
大殿沉重的大门缓缓开启，五长老快速进入到大殿中。

这才刚刚踏入大殿，五长老顿时感觉到一股莫大的压迫感落在自己身上。
身体猛然一滞，五长老只得停下脚步，想向前再跨出一步都非常困难。
“五长老，进来之前竟然不通报，真是……越来越没规矩了。”
幽暗之中传来一阵冰冷威严的声音，让人如芒在背。
只见那幽暗中，一道人影若隐若现。
感受到身上传来的压迫感，五长老不敢有丝毫怠慢，连忙跪下。
“启禀教主！属下有十分重要的事情禀报，此事事关重大，这才如此着急，还望恕罪！”
他并没有夸大其词，而是真的意识到这件事情比想的更严重。
得知非常紧急重要的事情，位于幽暗之中的冥鬼教主瞬间出现在五长老跟前。
速度之快，修为之高深，完全不是五长老能看穿的。
冥鬼教主身穿深暗银色长袍，那双猩红的眼睛以及头部的尖角，给人一种凶残无比的感觉。
仅仅只是身上逸散出来的气息，就给人一种生人勿近的感觉。
身体突然一轻，五长老连忙道。
“教主，事情的经过是这样的……”
五长老将整件事情陈述了一遍，不敢有一丝一毫的遗漏。
“教主，令牌在此，请您过目。”
说着，五长老又连忙将那枚令牌递过去。
接过令牌，冥鬼教主仔细地端详了一番，确定这就是他赐下的冥鬼教分部掌教令牌。
这东西竟然被带回来了，可问题是不是由分部掌教带回来的，这意味着冥鬼教分部如今应该凶多吉少。
content_en:
After receiving the fifth elder's promise, the disciple looked happy.
He was just an inconspicuous person in the Underworld Sect, and he didn't expect to achieve such a meritorious service in such a muddle-headed manner.
"Thank you, Fifth Elder! Thank you, Fifth Elder!"
"Remember, don't let the guy holding the token die, otherwise... you go and bury him with him."
The tone was solemn, and the fifth elder did not have no demands at all.
The demon from the branch who holds the token must have crucial information, and there must be no room for error.
If anything goes wrong, he won't let the kid in front of him go easily.
"Yes! Elder, please rest assured that my subordinates will not let him have any problems!"
He quickly cheered up, after all, this matter was related to his life.
If you are not careful, you may lose your life.
When he straightened up, he found that the fifth elder had left.
He did not dare to neglect at all. This matter was related to his life. He returned immediately to ensure that the demon holding the token could not die.
But the fifth elder holding the branch leader's token rushed to the Netherworld Sect's main hall without stopping.
Compared with the branches of the Yinming Mountains, the headquarters of the Jueming Mountains is several times larger.
The main hall located in the center of the mountain range is even more magnificent.
This is the core area of ​​the Underworld Cult, and usually only some core personnel can enter this place.
The fifth elder rushed into the main hall without even having time to inform anyone.
This matter is so serious that there is no room for any delay.
"Crunch——!!"
The heavy door of the main hall slowly opened, and the fifth elder quickly entered the main hall.
Just entering the hall, the fifth elder suddenly felt a great sense of oppression falling on him.
The body suddenly stagnated, and the fifth elder had to stop. It was very difficult to take another step forward.
"Fifth Elder, you didn't inform me before coming in. It's really... getting more and more unruly."
A cold and majestic voice came from the darkness, which made people feel like a light on their backs.
I saw a figure looming in the darkness.
Feeling the pressure coming from his body, the fifth elder did not dare to show any signs of neglect and quickly knelt down.
"Report to the leader! I have something very important to report. This matter is of great importance, so I am so anxious. I hope you will forgive me!"
He wasn't exaggerating, but he really realized that the matter was more serious than he thought.
After learning of the very urgent and important matter, the leader of the ghost ghost in the darkness instantly appeared in front of the fifth elder.
The speed is so fast and the cultivation is so profound that the Fifth Elder cannot see through it at all.
The ghost leader was wearing a dark silver robe, his scarlet eyes and the sharp horns on his head, giving people an extremely ferocious look.
Just the aura escaping from his body gives people a feeling that strangers should not approach him.
The body suddenly felt light, and the fifth elder said quickly.
"Master, what happened is this..."
The fifth elder stated the entire matter, not daring to omit even a single detail.
"Leader, the token is here, please take a look."
With that said, the fifth elder quickly handed over the token.
After receiving the token, the leader of the Underworld Cult looked at it carefully and confirmed that this was the token he gave to the leader of the Underworld Cult branch.
This thing was actually brought back, but the question is whether it was brought back by the branch leader, which means that the Ghost Sect branch should be in trouble now.
